information:
### Attendees are REQUIRED to read the [safety precautions tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewWinterA2021#16747-safety-precautions) in its ENTIRETY.
###  **BEFORE REGISTRATION** please be aware of [competitor responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewWinterA2021#16717-competitor-responsibilities) 
###  This is a twin competition with [Westview Winter B 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewWinterB2021). You may sign up to ONLY ONE competition (either A or B).
* This competition will be held **OUTDOORS** in the [plaza of Westview High School] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WestviewWinterA2021#16718-venue-and-directions).
* Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years - thanks!
* If any changes are made to the competition or schedule, they will be clearly announced to all competitors in an email
* **Schedule is tentative to change at the discretion of the organization team**
* Please **DO NOT** roam outside the plaza boundaries
* 1 guest per competitor
